p: covered his face: As they do that mourn.
house to the king: At Mahanaim.
gate: Where the most resort of the people haunted.
strife throughout all the tribes of: Everyone blamed another and strove who should first bring him home.
priests: That they should reprove the negligence of the elders, seeing the people were so forward.
room of Joab: By this policy David thought that by winning the captain, he would have the hearts of all the people.
Shimei the son of Gera: Who had before reviled him, 2Sa 16:13.
perversely the day that my lord: For in his adversity he was his most cruel enemy, and now in his prosperity, seeks by flattery to creep into favour.
Joseph to go down to meet: By Joseph he means Ephraim, Manasseh and Benjamin (of which he was) because those three were under one standard, Nu 2:18.
die: By my hands, or during my life, see 1Ki 2:8,9.
he was come to Jerusalem to: When Mephibosheth being at Jerusalem had met the King.
angel of God: Able for his wisdom to judge in all matters.
but dead men before my lord: Worthy to die for Saul's cruelty to you.
land: David did evil in taking his land from him before he knew the cause, but much worse, that knowing the truth, he did not restore them.
burden unto my lord the king: He thought it was not fitting to receive benefits from him to whom he was not able to do service again.
Gilgal: Where the tribe of Judah waited to receive him.
Israel: Who had taken the side of the king.
